# Tracked JavaScript files (.js, .mjs, .cjs, in any case) the repository
# keeps. Code of the repository is Go or TypeScript; "go run ./cmd/repotool
# check-js" in neodesk-server fails on any other JavaScript file.
#
# One path or glob per line, from the repository root, matched as written;
# * matches within a folder, ** any number of folders. Each entry has a
# comment right above it that says why the file stays JavaScript, and an
# entry that matches no tracked file fails the check too.

# Runs inside the MeshCentral agent's own JavaScript engine, not in Node or
# a browser, so it has to be JavaScript.
neodesk-server/meshcentral/assets/bettercore.js

# Files of a built web app that the embedding and file serving tests read:
# a build of the web app is JavaScript.
neodesk-server/console/embedfs/testdata/tree/_x/b.js
neodesk-server/console/webui/testdata/site/_ui/immutable/chunks/.hidden.js
neodesk-server/console/webui/testdata/site/_ui/immutable/chunks/raw.t3st.js
neodesk-server/console/webui/testdata/site/_ui/immutable/chunks/UPPER.JS
neodesk-server/console/webui/testdata/site/_ui/immutable/entry/start.t3st.js
neodesk-server/console/webui/testdata/site/_ui/immutable/nodes/0.t3st.js
